{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''prison facility''' was constructed on [[Selvaris]] sometime prior to or during [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] on the conquered [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Selvaris]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|galactic invasion]].

The base was typically Yuuzhan Vong, featuring [[Biot|organic structures and installations]]. It was overseen by [[Malik Carr]] and [[S'yito]].

==History==
As the world of Selvaris was [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] to serve the Vong, [[City/Legends|population centers]] were eradicated and the planet became a holding center for prisoners of the Yuuzhan Vong. A goodly contingent of the prisoners held onplanet were captured from recent battles, such as an [[Attack on Gyndine|abortive attempt to retake]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] and the failed [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|Operation Trinity]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

A [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] named [[Thorsh]] escaped the facility with two others in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], and was able to deliver an important code to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TUF" />

During transit to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a large sacrificial ceremony, most of the prisoners from the base were [[Battle of Selvaris|liberated]] over Selvaris by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TUF" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''
